messages:
zoe: quick follow-up from the p95 spike postmortem. recurring ~04:10 UTC bursts. root cause: cache reseed combined with per-zone routing skew. need owners for: (1) SLO policy + migration note, (2) dashboards + short-window alerts, (3) runbook + 04:10 playbook, (4) routing rebalancer + fallback metric. please claim by EOD PST.

rahul: i'll take (4). plan: implement a zone weight rebalancer, emit `rebalancer_actions_total`, and add a fallback_trigger metric. RFC by wed.

zoe: thanks. please include a canary roll for the rebalancer. we want metric-driven rollback.

cecilia: i'll own (2) and (3). dashboards: p95 5m sparkline, 1h trend, fallback activations counter with `reason` label. alert: `sum(increase(error_budget_burn[10m]))/sum(error_budget_total) > 0.01` -> page eng-platform. runbook: add checklist for cache evictions and exact curl steps to trigger fallback.

cecilia: runbook snippet:
```
# check evictions in last 10m
curl -s "https://metrics/api/v1/query?query=sum(increase(cache_evictions_total[10m]))"
# trigger fallback
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://deploy.internal/api/v1/routes/fallback -d '{"policy":"reduced-quant"}'
```

zoe: i will take (1). draft SLO PR will stage p95 tightening 320ms -> 210ms in canary for 72h, keep p99 at 1s. include dual-eval windows: 5m guard for paging, 1h for reporting. PR by fri.

ops-bot: IncidentBot: postmortem created at 2205001300 -> https://infra/reports/2205001234

rahul: RFC draft up -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/rfcs/940. will include rollback steps.

cecilia: staging dashboard ETA: thu. will link here when deployed.

zoe: action tracker: - zoe: SLO PR + migration note  due 2026-04-10 - cecilia: dashboards + runbook edits  due 2026-04-07 - rahul: rebalancer + fallback metric  due 2026-04-08. we'll run a coordinated smoke test and canary review after staging. thanks all.

rahul: noted. I'll also add a short loadtest to validate rebalancer behavior.

cecilia: posting staging dash link when ready.

o ps-bot: DeployTracker: dash-staging-v9 deployed at 2205001450
